in_hebrew.name: Hauger
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Strong, Brave Warrior
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Hauger הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old High German 'hagari' meaning 'hawk' or 'warrior'. In Norse mythology, Hauger was a name of a giant or troll.

in_greek.name: Hauger
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Strong, Brave Warrior
in_greek.long_meaning: Hauger είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Old High German 'hagari' meaning 'hawk' or 'warrior'. In Norse mythology, Hauger was a name of a giant or troll.

in_latin.name: Hauger
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Strong, Brave Warrior
in_latin.long_meaning: Hauger est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old High German 'hagari' meaning 'hawk' or 'warrior'. In Norse mythology, Hauger was a name of a giant or troll.
